speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gout with Uric Acid Nephrolithiasis (Kidney Stones). The clinical picture of recurrent monoarticular arthritis (ankle, now knee), uric acid crystals in urine, and flank pain associated with urination is classic for gouty nephrolithiasis. The negative renal ultrasound so far does not rule out small radiolucent stones or sludge, which explains the urinary symptoms.
